context.person: A person using a food delivery application
context.user_goal: Edit and confirm the amount before the change window closes.

product_state.preceding_state: The person wants to change a courier tip after the order was delivered.
product_state.current_state: The current tip is $6. The tip can be changed until 9:30 PM today.
known_facts: The tip can be changed until 9:30 PM today.
The courier sees the final amount after the change window closes.
forbidden_claims: The courier has already received the current amount.
Changing the tip changes the order total immediately without confirmation.

current_content.heading: Heads up!
current_content.body: Review the latest information and continue.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product banner so the person can understand tip change after delivery, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The selected tip remains changeable only until 9:30 PM.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Edit and confirm the amount before the change window closes.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
